response.sql: WITH district_clients AS (SELECT c.district_id, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c GROUP BY c.district_id), total_clients AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM client) SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(dc.client_count) AS average_clients_per_district, AVG(1.0 * dc.client_count / tc.n) AS average_share_of_all_clients FROM district_clients AS dc JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = dc.district_id CROSS JOIN total_clients AS tc GROUP BY d.A3;

assumptions.assumption: Each client is assigned to the branch district recorded in client.district_id.
